single.rationale: Walmart shows steady execution with consistent revenue growth (5.3% 3-year CAGR) and improving profitability, but the valuation appears stretched at 46.6x P/E and 68.4x P/FCF with modest free cash flow generation. The company faces multiple headwinds including elevated legal claims ($0.9B), rising capex intensity, and macro uncertainties around tariffs and consumer spending, though its scale advantages and growing higher-margin businesses (advertising, memberships) provide some offset.
